public_open_space.name: Foundry Square NE
public_open_space.description: This is one of three plazas fronting the intersection of 1st and Howard, forming Foundary Square. It features art sculptures and seating near a cafe.

public_art.title: The Signature
public_art.location: plaza in front of Foundry Square III
public_art.access: open space and artwork are always accessible
public_art.detail: A stainless steel sculpture required under the city's 1% for the arts program (Case No. 1998.902X), sited in the plaza in front of Foundry Square III.
